definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when making a request or asking someone to do something.
Used when ordering at a restaurant or shop.

examples.japanese: コーヒーをお{願|ねが}いします。
{手伝|てつだ}いをお{願|ねが}いします。
よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please treat me well. / Thank you in advance.

notes: お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most essential polite expressions. It literally means 'I make a request.' The casual form is お{願|ねが}い. よろしくお{願|ねが}いします is extremely common when meeting someone, starting a project, or asking for continued cooperation.
